groups.activity: conservation (Vasca Kavat) at night, or bounties

rows.label: Visitor
rows.note: 22,000 standing, 25,000cr, 10 Tear Azurite, 40 Pyrol, 60 Fish Scales; unlocks the Marquise Veridos and Fersteel Alloy refine blueprints

rows.label: Trusted
rows.note: 44,000 standing, 50,000cr, 1 Cetus Wisp, 5 Maprico; unlocks gilding and Vargeet II Jai

conditions: The Dokrahm blueprint is buyable at Neutral, but 7 Marquise Veridos are required to build it and the refine blueprint is Visitor-locked — don't buy component blueprints you can't build yet.
Daily standing cap is 16,000 + 500 per Mastery Rank, so this is inherently multi-day.
bonuses: Conservation at night (Vasca Kavat with the tranq rifle, or Ivara invisible with Sleep Arrow) caps the daily limit in 10-20 minutes; faster than bounties or fishing/mining.

disclosures.title: why the standing bill is so high
disclosures.body: Reaching Trusted alone costs 71,000 standing and 85,000 credits sacrificed across three rank-ups, before spending a single point on the blueprints themselves.

groups.activity: buy the Strike, Grip and refine blueprints

rows.label: Korb Grip Blueprint
rows.alt: Peye for max speed, same Scythe class

conditions: Grip choice is one-way and locks the weapon type forever: Korb/Peye make a Scythe, Shtung/Seekalla/Jayap/Kroostra make a Heavy Blade.

Every 2H Zaw has a hidden Damage Factor; Dokrahm's Scythe build reads the same base damage as the Heavy Blade build but the Heavy Blade silently loses 7% of total damage. Pick the Heavy Blade only for its 3.0m range over the Scythe's 1.7m.
bonuses: Hok's forge screen previews any Strike/Grip/Link combination, including parts you don't own yet — always preview before committing, since a built Zaw can never be taken apart.

groups.activity: buy the Vargeet II Jai link

rows.label: Vargeet II Jai Blueprint
rows.alt: any cheap link if you only want the mastery

groups.activity: mine Veridos, collect Cetus Wisps, run Excavation for Cryotic

rows.label: Cetus Wisp
rows.note: needed for gilding; sweep lake shorelines with Loot Detector
rows.alt: buy for 2,000 standing at Onkko if Quills rank 5

rows.label: Cryotic
rows.note: Excavation (Hieracon, Pluto); 6 Pyrotic Alloy batches at 200 each

conditions: Cetus Wisps no longer despawn (fixed Update 34), but Vacuum/Greedy Pull don't collect them — you have to physically touch each one.
Only 3-4 Wisps spawn per Plains instance by day, 6-8 at night, and they don't respawn after the set is cleared.
bonuses: Titania in Razorwing or Itzal make sweeping the shorelines for Wisps fast.

rows.label: Dokrahm Strike
rows.note: 5,000cr, 25 Nistlepod, 45 Fish Scales, 7 Marquise Veridos, 60 Pyrotic Alloy, 1h

rows.label: Vargeet II Jai Link
rows.note: 5 Maprico, 20 Fersteel Alloy, 5 Kuaka Spinal Claw, 5 Mortus Horn

rows.label: gild at rank 30
rows.note: 2 Cetus Wisp + 5,000 Ostron standing; resets to rank 0, level again

conditions: Mastery is per Strike, not per weapon; once a gilded Dokrahm hits 30, every future Dokrahm is worth zero mastery.
A built Zaw can never be disassembled — confirm grip and link before assembling.
bonuses: Level both passes somewhere fast like Elite Sanctuary Onslaught or Hydron.
